name: project_brand
title: Project Brand & Media
summary: Brand & media section of a project page.
description: Brand & media section: a project's web media images (default web/media-website/*: banners, logo, wallpapers) in the same masonry as the photo gallery (renders project_gallery, no filters / paging by default): every image at its own shape, logos first on the canvas color, each opens in the popup gallery. A <section> of its own with a section_head.
